title: dspy
summary: DSPy is a framework for programming Large Language Models (LLMs) and Retrieval Models (RMs) by composing small, declarative modules. It enables developers to build complex LLM applications by defining program flow and optimizing prompts and weights automatically. DSPy streamlines the development, evaluation, and deployment of LLM-powered systems, making them more robust and efficient.

nodes.label: Developer / User
nodes.title: Human User
nodes.description: The primary actor who designs, runs, and evaluates DSPy programs to build robust LLM applications.

nodes.label: Core Program Abstractions
nodes.title: DSPy Core Abstractions
nodes.description: Defines the foundational building blocks for DSPy programs, including base modules, signature definitions, standardized data types, and adapters for LM communication.

nodes.label: Language Model Integration
nodes.title: DSPy LM Integration Layer
nodes.description: Manages all interactions with Language Models, providing client integrations, caching for performance, API-specific data formatting, and essential utilities.

nodes.label: Program Execution & Control
nodes.title: DSPy Program Execution
nodes.description: Orchestrates how DSPy programs run, encompassing advanced prediction strategies, agentic control flow, real-time output streaming, external tool integration, and robust prediction aggregation.

nodes.label: Optimization & Tuning
nodes.title: DSPy Program Optimization
nodes.description: Provides a suite of teleprompters and tools for automatically optimizing DSPy programs, enabling automated prompt engineering, few-shot example selection, and program refinement.

nodes.label: Data Retrieval & Evaluation
nodes.title: DSPy Data & Evaluation
nodes.description: Offers comprehensive tools for managing datasets, integrating various retrieval systems to fetch relevant information, and providing metrics for evaluating DSPy program performance.

nodes.label: General Utilities
nodes.title: DSPy General Utilities
nodes.description: A collection of essential utility functions for DSPy, including tools for managing asynchronous/synchronous execution, callbacks, file downloading, and dummy implementations for testing.
